hidden_cases.interpretation: Six of nine forms are missed. Two are squarely inside the frozen deliverable's own wording: '/data/po03/artifact' and '/Volumes/Extern/po03' are absolute filesystem paths that are not flagged, and '$HOME/po03/artifact' and '%USERPROFILE%\po03\artifact' are user home references that are not flagged. Root cause: the machine-root regex is a CLOSED enumeration of eight roots (workspace|root|opt|var|etc|usr|mnt|srv), so the component does not detect absolute paths as a class - it detects a hardcoded list of them. Separately, i_shebang.txt shows a false positive: the portable shebang '#!/usr/bin/env python3' is reported as a 'machine-root' non-portability, which is why 14 machine-root findings appear on the real repository.

producer_declared_limitations: Binary and non-UTF-8 artifacts are intentionally skipped and require format-specific extraction.
undeclared_limitations_found_by_reviewer: 'Absolute filesystem paths' are not detected as a class; machine-root is a closed enumeration of eight roots, so /data, /scratch and /Volumes pass unflagged.
'$HOME/...' and '%USERPROFILE%\...' user home references are not detected, though the deliverable names user home references explicitly.
The portable '#!/usr/bin/env python3' shebang is a false positive reported as machine-root.
No evidence at all from the real committed PO-03 tree; all producer evidence is synthetic fixtures the regexes were authored against.
No allowlist artifact is shipped, so the real-repository output is 296 findings dominated by the commission's own /tmp prohibition text.

reproducibility_check: Stable across fresh python3 -I processes; the real-repository scan reproduced identical finding counts on a second run.
divergence_reason: The producer's PASS rests exclusively on synthetic fixtures authored to match its own regexes. When I probed the categories the frozen deliverable itself names, the component missed six of nine non-portable forms, including two plain absolute filesystem paths (/data/po03/artifact, /Volumes/Extern/po03) and two user home references ($HOME/..., %USERPROFILE%\...). The component does not detect absolute paths as a class; machine-root is a closed list of eight roots. It also produces a false positive on the portable '#!/usr/bin/env python3' shebang. None of this is declared in the producer's limitations, and the scanner was never run against the real committed PO-03 tree that the hypothesis is about. The mechanism is real and non-vacuous, so this is not a FAIL - but 'absolute paths ... are mechanically detectable' is not yet established, so the correct verdict is NOT_YET.
disposition_reason: REJECTED as an aggregate PASS, not as work product. The scanner is sound, non-vacuous and operable at real scale (328 artifacts scanned cleanly), and it should be retained. What must not be accepted is the unqualified PASS: the frozen deliverable's own categories 'absolute filesystem paths' and 'user home references' are materially under-covered, the evidence base contains no real-repository run, and a documentation allowlist required by the deliverable is designed but never shipped. Recommend re-verdict to NOT_YET with the six missed forms added as pattern coverage, the /usr/bin/env false positive suppressed, and one real-repository run plus a shipped allowlist added as evidence.
followups_for_coordinator: Extend machine-root beyond its eight-root enumeration, or add a general POSIX-absolute-path pattern, so /data, /scratch and /Volumes are not silently portable.
Add $HOME, %USERPROFILE% and expanduser('~') to the home-reference patterns.
Suppress '#!/usr/bin/env' as a portable idiom rather than reporting it as machine-root (14 of 14 real-repository machine-root findings on non-test files are shebangs).

Ship the documentation allowlist the frozen deliverable requires; without it the real-repository run emits 296 findings, 134 from the commission's own /tmp prohibition text in workstreams/po03/control/wave-a-spec.json.
